example: Newcastle upon Tyne, with simulated car and phone inputs; This demonstration uses controlled learned records and a real map-backed diversion calculated by production routing

v223-nearby-pois.gif.routing_provenance: Real Newcastle POI tiles scanned offline by production nearby_scan() from the installed CPM5 map bundle (Z5 3x3 inner pass plus Z3 expanding rings), using production remote handlers to add a stop to the itinerary.

v223-secondary-manoeuvre.gif.routing_provenance: Real Newcastle city-centre route calculated by production routing from the installed CPR2 routing graph. Vehicle movement along route vertices is simulated; production nav_maneuver_find() and nav_next_maneuver_find() drive both Turn cards.

v223-view-diversion.gif.routing_provenance: Real Newcastle route and legal alternative geometry from the installed CPR2 routing graph. Historical congestion observations are controlled examples. The production traffic search, shared-geometry rendering, BT CTRL, Explore diversion preview and direct map confirmation handler are used. This is not a claim about actual traffic conditions.

v224-ml-eta-and-habits.gif.routing_provenance: Real Durham (Gilesgate to Neville's Cross) route and legal usual-route alternative from the installed CPR2 routing graph with zero historical traffic congestion, driven by production ml_pref_arcs search and calibrated ETA variance (active route stays normal route colour with no yellow bypass).

v224-ml-slowdowns.gif.routing_provenance: Real York (Station to Heworth) route from the installed CPR2 routing graph with production ml_observe_decel() / ml_hazard_level() / traffic_scan_ex() demonstrating warm repeat slowdown alerts, deduplication, cold-only silence at 18C, cold-weather slowdown alerts at 1C and winter-calibrated ETA.

v224-ml-parking-and-pois.gif.routing_provenance: Real Newcastle city-centre routing and offline CPM5 POI tiles, with controlled local ML parking, recurring-stop and fuel-affinity records driving production confirmation sheets, route-coloured POI highlighting and Nearby POI ranking.

v224-ml-adaptive-hud.gif.routing_provenance: Real Newcastle map tiles demonstrating production ml_note_zoom_override() speed-band Auto-zoom personalisation and ml_learned_brightness() automatic Day-to-Night brightness adjustment on an Auto theme transition.

v220-intelligent-diversions.gif.routing_provenance: Real Newcastle route and legal alternative geometry from the installed CPR2 routing graph.
